title: Explore Japan: Tokyo and Osaka
alt: Senso-ji temple gate in Asakusa, Tokyo
transport: Bullet train, private transfers and guided day tours

stops.name: Tokyo
stops.subtitle: Tokyo to Mount Fuji and Hakone
stops.accom: 3 nights · Breakfast · Standard room · 3★ · Neat hotel in Hamamatsucho, close to the monorail

activities.name: Tokyo city tour with lunch
activities.description: A full day by coach from Matsuya Ginza through Meiji shrine, the Imperial Palace gardens and the temple lanes of Asakusa, with lunch included.

activities.name: Mount Fuji and Hakone day trip
activities.match: Mount Fuji and Hakone 1 Day Tour
activities.description: The fifth station on Mount Fuji, Lake Ashi and the Hakone ropeway, with the bullet train back into Tokyo in the evening.

program.name: Tokyo
program.description: Three nights in Hamamatsucho, with a full city day and a day out to Mount Fuji and the Hakone lakes.

stops.name: Osaka
stops.subtitle: Osaka to Kyoto and Nara
stops.accom: 2 nights · Breakfast · Standard room · 3★ · Reliable hotel in central Osaka, a short walk to the subway

activities.name: Kyoto and Nara day trip
activities.match: Kyoto and Nara Sightseeing Day Tour
activities.description: A full day out of Osaka for Kinkaku-ji, the golden pavilion, and then the deer park and Todai-ji temple in Nara.

program.name: Osaka
program.description: Two nights in central Osaka with a full day in Kyoto and Nara, and the food streets on your doorstep.

1: Arrival at Narita or Haneda and transfer to your hotel
Check in at your hotel in Hamamatsucho
Rest of the day free at your own pace
Optional: an evening walk through the Shiba park gardens
2: Breakfast, then a full day coach tour of the city
Meiji shrine and the Imperial Palace gardens
Asakusa and the Senso-ji temple lanes
3: Breakfast, then out of the city towards Mount Fuji
The fifth station on the mountain, weather permitting
Lake Ashi and the Hakone ropeway
Bullet train back into Tokyo in the evening
4: Breakfast and check out, then transfer to the station
Check in at your hotel in the centre
Rest of the day free in the city
5: Breakfast, then a full day out of Osaka
Kinkaku-ji, the golden pavilion, on its pond
The deer park and Todai-ji temple in Nara
Back in Osaka for the evening
6: Breakfast at the hotel and check out
Private transfer to Kansai Airport for your flight home

expert.name: Aiko
expert.quote: The shortest trip that still gets you Fuji, Kyoto and Nara. Simple hotels, strong days out.
expert.tip: Keep the last evening for Dotonbori. Osaka eats late and the hotel is a short subway ride from the stalls.

summary: Six days between Tokyo and Osaka: three nights in Hamamatsucho with a guided city day and a Mount Fuji and Hakone trip, then two nights in central Osaka with a full day in Kyoto and Nara.
included: Included: 5 nights with daily breakfast; bullet train from Tokyo to Osaka; private airport transfers; full day Tokyo city tour with lunch; Mount Fuji and Hakone day trip with bullet train return; Kyoto and Nara sightseeing day tour.
not_included: Not included: international flights; Japan visa fees; other lunches and dinners; travel insurance; personal expenses.
